subject: Surveillance of {{reportTarget}} returns no usable result

locus.descriptor: the secure briefing room where the issued report is on the desk

opening.text: The surveillance return cannot support a judgment about {{reportTarget}}. The President can send a new collection question or close the first request. {{reportSummary}}
The gaps are recorded too: {{reportGaps}} That limit belongs on any answer the administration gives from this desk.
There is no finding to put to their government. A new tasking keeps the question alive; closing it ends this collection path without settling the matter.

replies.text: Task a separate search of foreign communications about {{reportTarget}} and keep the empty return out of any public claim.

collection.question: What foreign communications bear on this government’s current posture?

commitment.remembered: The President tasked a separate search of foreign communications after the issued surveillance return supplied no usable result.

rejoinder.text: The new tasking is recorded. It gives us another route to an answer, but no new finding comes with the order.

replies.text: Task an all-source comparison of existing reporting about {{reportTarget}} before deciding whether to approach its government.

collection.question: What existing reporting bears on this government’s current posture?

commitment.remembered: The President ordered an all-source comparison after the issued surveillance return supplied no usable result.

rejoinder.text: Analysts can compare what is already held. If the sources have the same blind spot, the comparison will preserve it.

replies.text: Close this collection tasking and say only that the return supplied no usable result.

commitment.remembered: The President closed the surveillance tasking without claiming its empty return had cleared the target.

rejoinder.text: The original tasking closes. Its recorded gaps remain with the issued report; they do not become a finding.

context.standing: An issued surveillance report reached the President through the secure channel. It returned no usable result about {{reportTarget}}. The original tasking remains on the collection ledger.
context.precedent: An empty collection return can mean the operation saw nothing or could not see enough. A new tasking changes what the intelligence community is asked to collect; closing the first ends that request.

pressures.want: The intelligence community wants a fresh collection question because the issued return could not answer the first.
The Secretary of State wants the President to avoid treating an empty return as evidence of safety or grounds for an accusation.

context.inaction: The original tasking stays open without a new question. The President receives no assurance from the absence of usable reporting, and the recorded gap remains.
context.unknown: The issued return cannot establish whether activity beyond the operation’s view exists, because the operation never supplied a usable observation.
